title: Sent to SRI to assess the Gondola Wish project, then assigned to it

tellings.quote: he found out that he had a think this thing called Gondola wish starting at Fort me and he was nervous about it

plain: In 1978 Joe McMoneagle, an Army intelligence soldier, says he was sent to the Stanford Research Institute, a research lab in California, to judge an Army project called Gondola Wish, which was testing whether people could spy using the mind alone, and then was put on the project himself. He says a general he calls General Roya had learned the project was starting at Fort Meade, an Army base in Maryland, and was nervous about it. McMoneagle tells it as how he became one of the Army's psychic spies.
